'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest item from the [[Better Save Soul]] DLC. After unlocking the DLC, this item can be obtained during a new [[Gerry]] questline. This questline requires {{Item|A mug of beer|1|1}} and {{Item|River sand|1}} to unlock the '''{{PAGENAME}}''' item. (''Note: No other quality beer is acceptable.'')

This item can be used to continue the [[Euric]] questline to unlock the [[Souls room]] next to the [[Morgue]].
